title: Revise the IFX draft bundle for the local scoped 1.1.2 base
goal: Freeze a 0.2.0 IFX draft whose root-scope claim is bound to the certified 1.1.2 candidate, while retaining explicit unmapped gates and no human acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: The earlier 0.1.0 draft remains unchanged and the new draft binds exact V3_ifx source hashes plus the 1.1.2 local base identity.
The new Profile, module selection and ordinal full-file bundle manifest validate against the local 1.1.2 contracts and module registry.
Missing IFX detector families, specialized gates and human review remain explicit; no release, composition or activation occurs.
